title: Ibrox Stadium: overview

description: Ibrox Stadium stands in Glasgow, Scotland: a 50,817-capacity venue opened in 1899, home to Rangers. The other half of the Old Firm. Stadiums are the cathedrals of sport — concrete memory banks where generations experienced the same joys and heartbreaks. This database covers the ground's history, architecture, great events, and how to visit it.

title: History
d: Ibrox Stadium opened in 1899. The other half of the Old Firm..
definition: Ibrox Stadium opened in 1899. The other half of the Old Firm..
description: The history of Ibrox Stadium begins in 1899. The other half of the Old Firm. Like all great grounds, it has been rebuilt, renamed, and reborn — stands rising where terraces stood, roofs arriving decades after the first kick. Its timeline is the timeline of its tenants' triumphs and the city's love affair with the game.

Renovations keep adding hospitality while trying not to dilute the soul.

title: The tenants
d: Ibrox Stadium is home to Rangers.

When the team thrives the stadium shakes; when it struggles the old ground groans with it. You cannot separate the venue from its people.
